shots.vo: Blinding headlights at night are a whole different kind of scary.

shots.vo: These are night driving glasses that fit right over your regular ones. The yellow lenses are designed to help reduce glare from oncoming headlights. And look, there's a little yellow window on each side, so the glare can't sneak in from the side.
